purpose: Provenance register for the idealized GIZA PRIME multiscale reference model.
statement: No external citation is attached to this package. The identifier synthetic_reference_fixture is an internal placeholder for synthetic idealized values and is NOT a publication, survey, dataset or citation. No survey values, coordinates, elevations, published measurements, URLs, authors or page numbers are asserted here.
synthetic_fixture_definition: Internal deterministic fixture: all numeric parameters in parameter_registry.json are round synthetic values chosen only to exercise the equations and software controls. They carry evidence class idealized_design or assumption_for_sensitivity (or unknown where the value is null). They are not measurements and not reconstructed historical facts.
missing_data_policy: Where a value is unavailable it is stored as null with evidence class unknown, status not_evaluable_missing_data and a discriminating measurement is named. Missing values are never filled with unmarked averages.
frame_policy: No real coordinate frame, vertical datum or epoch is claimed. All synthetic geometry lives in a declared synthetic local Cartesian frame with an ideal datum z=0; combining heterogeneous real frames is explicitly deferred until common control points are derived.
